newest.title: New $29 Million Funding for Agentic Data Science: Efficiency or Enterprise Risk?
newest.description: New $29 Million Funding for Agentic Data Science: Efficiency or Enterprise Risk. RapidCanvas just secured $29 million to automate data science, but we’re digging into whether these agents actually replace expertise or just create new technical debt. Join us to see if your team should be buying in. What we covered: • RapidCanvas Secures $29 Million Series B Funding for Agentic Data Science • States sue OpenAI over ChatGPT child-safety claims and alleged deception • Anthropic opens employee-level access to METR researchers Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: When an AI agent makes a significant error at work, who should be held responsible? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. Follow The AI Edge on Spotify for a new AI news and analysis episode every weekday.
